description: One imported page's provenance, version 1, kept at .neo/<bookId>/pages/<chId>.json for a page in a NEO book, or at .neo/pages/<tree>/<path>.json for a page file in wiki/ or sources/: the Markdown file it was imported from, that file's SHA-256 when it came in, and its frontmatter as read. NEO never shows the frontmatter.

path.description: The file as it was picked, an absolute path on the machine that imported it.

name.description: The page's title when it came in: the file's name without .md, or the name an import list gave it.

sections.description: For a page cut from part of the file (a split), the headings whose sections it holds, or the line ranges (L12-L40) it holds, in order.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole file's bytes, in hex, a split's too.

frontmatter.description: The frontmatter as read, dates as written; null for a page with none.

written.description: For a page file in wiki/ or sources/: SHA-256 of the page file as the import last wrote it, in hex. While the file still hashes so, nobody has changed it, and a newer source updates it in place.
